{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"Polymarket Data API v2","description":"The Polymarket Data API: wallet portfolios, trade and activity feeds, market state and ranked boards.

## Conventions every endpoint shares

- **Envelope**: every response wraps its payload in `data` (paged routes add `pagination`). A documented miss is `data: null` or an empty list, never an error.
- **Pagination is cursor-only**: follow `pagination.next_cursor` until `null`; `has_more` is exact, and there is no `offset` query parameter (sending one is a `400`). Cursors are signed, typed per endpoint, and opaque. The feeds (`trades`, `activity`, combo activity) are keyset walks, stable across concurrent writes; the boards, `holders` and most combo-position sorts are offset walks behind the opaque token, so a page taken across a data refresh can skip or repeat rows. Where a cursor binds its cohort (the boards, positions, combo positions), resuming bare is fine, restating the same values is fine, and contradicting them is a `400`. The `trades`/`activity` feed cursors carry only the seek anchor and page size (plus the sort direction on activity): re-send identical filters on every page, because changing one mid-walk re-anchors silently.
- **Rate limiting**: `429` with `Retry-After` is the busy signal for heavy queries. A heavy query may first be queued briefly for a capacity slot; the `429` arrives only if that short wait ends unserved. Each caller also has a per-client request allowance, and bursts past it get the same `429` with `Retry-After` sized to the remaining wait. Retry after the given delay. A request that could not get a database connection within its budget is NOT a `429`: it is a `503` `request_timeout` with `Retry-After`, because the shortage is on the server side, not in the caller's rate.
- **Identifiers**: `condition` (aliases `condition_id`, `conditionId`) is the unified query key for on-chain 0x condition ids; `market_id` fields carry Gamma's own market ids; `event_id` takes Gamma event ids; `token_id` is the CLOB asset id (the key on `/v2/prices-history`).
- **Params** accept both snake_case and camelCase spellings.
- **Units**: bare `volume`/`size` values are **shares**; `_usdc` suffixed fields are USD; `taker_` prefixed volumes are one-side.
- **Sentinels**: `outcome_index: 999` means the outcome could not be labeled; a missing or `null` numeric field means unavailable, never zero.
- **Windows on `/v2/trades?user=` and `/v2/activity`**: an omitted or `

schema Position:
archived: Whether the market is archived; tells a caller using `includeArchived`
which rows the flag surfaced.
avg_price: Weighted-average entry price per share, in USDC.
condition_id: The on-chain condition id.
current_price: Live mark per share, in USDC.
current_size: The CURRENT holding, in shares (~0 residual on the CLOSED arm).
current_value: `current_size × current_price`, in USDC.
end_date: Market end date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; `1970-01-01` when Gamma has none.
entry_cost_usdc: The fee-EXCLUSIVE entry basis.

entry_fees_usdc: Attributed BUY-fee total for the position. Disclosure only:
`entry_cost_usdc` is already fee-exclusive, so never re-deduct this
fr
event_id: Gamma event id of the parent event.
event_slug: Parent event slug.
first_entry_at: First acquisition of the position (buy, split, mint, transfer in), epoch seconds; 0 when no acquisition is recorded.
icon: Market icon URL.
last_event_at: The row's last economics event, epoch seconds; 0 without native state.

mergeable: Whether the wallet also holds the opposite outcome, so the pair can
merge back into collateral.
name: Profile display name of the wallet.
negative_risk: Whether the market belongs to a neg-risk group.
opposite_outcome: Label of the market's other outcome; what a merge pairs with.
opposite_token_id: Token id of the market's other outcome.
outcome: Label of the held outcome (e.g. `Yes`).

outcome_index: Index of the held outcome within the market; `999` means the outcome
could not be labeled.

percent_pnl: `(current_value - entry_cost_usdc) / entry_cost_usdc`, as a percent.
Fee-exclusive basis, and the numerator is `unrealized_pnl`; n

percent_realized_pnl: `(current_value - total_size × avg_price) / (total_size × avg_price)`,
as a percent. A compatibility shape: despite the name, it i
profile_image: Profile image URL.
proxy_wallet: Proxy wallet holding the position.
realized_pnl: Realized PnL in USDC, cumulative for the position.

redeemable: Whether the position can be redeemed now: its market resolved and the
tokens are still held (losing sides included; redeemable ≠ w
slug: Market slug; the URL segment on polymarket.com.

status: The row's actual state; can be narrower than the requested `status`,
since an `OPEN` request also returns `REDEEMABLE` rows.
title: Market question title (Gamma enrichment; empty when unenriched).
token_id: The outcome token id.

total_cost_usdc: Gross (fee-INCLUSIVE) basis. Always exactly
`entry_cost_usdc + entry_fees_usdc`; the contract sums the two served
columns, so the
total_pnl: Always equals `realized_pnl + unrealized_pnl`.

total_size: LIFETIME bought shares (the WAC denominator), never the
current balance; that is `current_size`.
unrealized_pnl: Unrealized (mark-to-market) PnL: `current_value - entry_cost_usdc`.
verified: Profile verification badge.
schema UserStats: biggest_win: Largest single resolved win, in USDC.
join_date: Epoch seconds, or `null` when the join date is unknown.
proxy_wallet: The proxy wallet these lifetime statistics describe.
trades: Distinct markets the wallet traded; an exact count.
schema LeaderboardUserEntry:
pnl: Window PnL in USDC, same semantics as the board rows (finite windows
marked, `all` realized-only).
rank_pnl: `None` when unranked on the PnL board.
rank_volume: `None` when unranked on the volume board.
user_name: Profile display name of the wallet.
volume: Both-sides traded volume in shares; never USD.
x_username: Linked X handle, when one exists.
